question: Who is the author of the historical fiction novel 'The Mauryan: The Legend of Ashoka'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Komal Bhanver**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Komal Bhanver** is the author of the historical fiction novel "**The Mauryan: The Legend of Ashoka**".
 
• The book delves into the life and rise of Emperor Ashoka, one of the most significant rulers in Indian history.
 
• It offers a fictionalized yet deeply researched portrayal of Ashoka's journey from a young prince to the Mauryan emperor.
 
• The novel blends historical facts with creative storytelling to bring alive the Mauryan era and Ashoka's transformation into a legendary figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashoka the Great:**

 
 
• Ashoka was the third ruler of the Mauryan Empire, reigning from 268 to 232 BCE.
 
• He is best known for his role in spreading Buddhism and his policy of Dhamma (righteousness).
 
• His reign marked a significant era of cultural and economic prosperity in ancient India.
 
 
 
• **The Mauryan Empire:**
 
 
• Founded by Chandragupta Maurya in 321 BCE, it was one of the largest empires in Indian history.
 
• The empire reached its zenith under Ashoka, encompassing most of the Indian subcontinent.
 
 
 
• **Historical Fiction Genre:**
 
 
• This genre blends historical facts with fictional elements to create engaging narratives.
 
• It often focuses on significant events, figures, or eras while adding imaginative details.
 
 
 
• **Other Works by Komal Bhanver:**
 
 
• Komal Bhanver is also known for her contributions as an author and corporate professional.
 
• She has written books that explore themes of leadership and personal growth.
